---
title: "Lectures"
---

The workshop is built around an **overview** lecture (Lec 00) plus eight topic lectures. Each numbered lecture pairs with one or more tutorials of the matching number — read the lecture first, then work the matching tutorial(s).

## Lecture series

| # | Lecture | Pairs with |
|---|---|---|
| 00 | [Bulk vs. Single-Cell RNA-seq: What & How](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_00_Bulk_vs_scRNAseq.html) | (overview — sets up everything below) |
| 01 | [Pre-processing: QC, doublets, normalization, HVGs](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_01_Preprocessing.html) | [Tutorial 01 — QC & Preprocessing](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_01_QC_Preprocessing.html) |
| 02 | [Dim Reduction, Integration & Clustering](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_02_DimRed_Integration_Clustering.html) | [Tutorial 02 — Dim Reduction & Clustering](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_02_DimReduction_Clustering.html) + [Tutorial 04 — Two-Sample Integration](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_04_Integration.html) |
| 03 | [Markers & Manual Cell-Type Annotation](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_03_Markers_Annotation.html) | [Tutorial 03 — Markers & Annotation](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_03_Markers_Annotation.html) |
| 04 | [Pseudobulk DE & DESeq2](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_04_Pseudobulk_DE.html) | [Tutorial 05 — DESeq2 Primer on `airway`](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_05_Primer_DESeq2_Basics.html) + [Tutorial 06 — Pseudobulk DE](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_06_Pseudobulk_DE.html) + [Tutorial 07 — Functional Analysis](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_07_FunctionalAnalysis.html) + [Tutorial 08 — Differential Abundance](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_08_DifferentialAbundance.html) |
| 05 | [Reference-based Annotation: SingleR & Azimuth](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_05_Reference_Annotation.html) | [Tutorial 09 — Reference Annotation](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_09_Reference_Annotation.html) |
| 06 | [Bulk & Single-Cell ATAC-seq](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_06_ATACseq.html) | [Tutorial 10 — scATAC-seq with Signac](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_10_scATACseq_Signac.html) |
| 07 | [WGCNA: Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_07_WGCNA.html) | [Tutorial 11 — WGCNA on GSE152418](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_11_WGCNA.html) |
| 08 | [FAIR Principles & Data Sharing](Lecture_Folder/Lecture_08_FAIR_DataSharing.html) | [Tutorial 13 — FAIR Metadata & Submission](Exercise_Folder/Tutorial_13_FAIR_Metadata.html) |

## Pre-requisite computational background

The pre-requisite computational tools (computing fundamentals, Unix, R, Git, HPC) are not presented as lectures. They live as long-form reading material under [Resources](Resources.qmd).
